situation: Two nuclear-armed blocs in a brinkmanship standoff over a strait — mutual escalation is the worst outcome, backing down is survivable

players.name: BlocA
players.note: Signals resolve but fears misread, escalates gradually

players.name: BlocB
players.note: Tests opponent early, then mirrors or locks in

rationale.T: swerve while they hold firm = political win without war
rationale.S: swerve? actually hold firm while they swerve? No — S is swerving while they swerve? In chicken S> P: mutual defect (both hold firm) is catastrophe
